page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and has no local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance sits primarily in the lower tiers for CPU and memory operations. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 953.38 is categorized in the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 4755.08 falls in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show weak performance, with read-only large block speeds at 37.18 GB/sec and write speeds at 25.34 GB/sec. Passmark CPU testing yields an average score of 6698.53, though extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests remain in the bottom 25%. Database operations and Redis SET throughput of 5.48 million operations per second also align with the lower performance tier.

The qualitative cost efficiency of the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is tied to its older hardware profile, specifically the Intel Broadwell-generation CPU and Pascal-generation GPU. While it provides dedicated CPU cores and hardware acceleration, the overall processing and memory throughput are lower than modern standards. The lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. This instance is best suited for entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks such as small-scale inference, legacy CUDA applications, basic video transcoding, or lightweight graphics rendering where high-end compute performance is not a primary requirement.
